description_en: Creates an image search application instance
description_zh: 调用该接口创建以图搜图应用实例
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual create-picture-search-app --name '以图搜图' --desc '以图搜图Demo' --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePictureSearchApp

parameters.help_en:
The name of the image search application instance. 

The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name can be up to 64 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters
parameters.help_zh:
以图搜图应用实例的名称。 

支持中文汉字、英文大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度不超过64个字符，一个汉字算2个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the image search application instance.

The description can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The description can be up to 1024 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters
parameters.help_zh:
以图搜图应用实例的描述信息。

支持中文汉字、英文大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度不超过1024个字符，一个汉字算2个字符
parameters.name: desc

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

If the public instance does not have an ID value, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en:
The response code.
200: Success.
Other values: Error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288314.html）
Code.description_zh:
接口返回码：
200：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288314.html）

Data.description_en: The instance ID of the image search application

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息
ErrorMessage.example: Name is mandatory for this action.

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功：
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
